verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official Databricks SDK for Python for automating operations and development. The API reference says examples are given using 'one or more of the Databricks SDKs', and the Databricks Connect client library can be embedded in any application. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Python, in-depth SDK feature documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: you learn how to automate Databricks operations and accelerate development with the Databricks SDK for Python
Some reference pages also provide examples for calling a Databricks REST API operation by using the Databricks CLI, the Databricks Terraform provider, or one or more of the Databricks SDKs.
Just like a JDBC driver, the Databricks Connect library can be embedded in any application to interact with Databricks.
